listing.name: Minor Balance Tweaks (unhinged)
listing.summary: Did you ever wish fighters were broken? Like they had too many guns? And they freaking shredded you? Did you miss the time when fighters were really obnoxious and for some reason wanted to experience that for yourself? In a modern equivalent of that? WELL, this mod is for you then
listing.aiSummary: Rebalances ships, weapons, and systems to make fighters more powerful and adjust fleet composition costs.

description:
Download link:
https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/Unhinged-Balance-Tweak/releases/download/Starsector/Minor.Balance.Tweaks.zip

List of changes:

Spoiler
General ships:
- All Derelicts, with the exception of the Rampart and Guardian, have had their durability vastly increased (500 bonus hull and 100 armour for frigates, 2k hull and 150 armour for destroyers)
- Afflictor has had its ship system swapped to that of Harbinger
- Threat DP costs increased by 50%, which affects the rate at which they are built
- PTS costs are now roughly equivalent to DP costs (PTS formula is DP cost -1 for every 10 DP points, every 5, 15, 25...) [some unique ships are exempted from this formula]

Frigates:
- Centurion, Vanguard, Gremlin and Brawler have had their DP increased to 6
- Gremlin now uses Canister Flak (Manticore's ship system) instead of fighter flares
- Omen, Tempest, Vigilance, Brawler have had their shield profiles drastically reduced
- Afflictor's DP is now 10 and 8 at pirate variant
- Mudskipper has had its hull and armour durability doubled
- Gremlin, Afflictor, Shade have had their armour and hull durability values reverted to before THIS update
- Wolf has received an omni-directional shield with a slightly smaller shield profile
- Cerberus and Wayfarer's hull durability and armour stats increased by the same quantity Gremlin got some time ago
- Reduced Omen's DP from 6 to 5

Destroyers:
- Shrike DP cost increased by 1, pirate Shrike cost unchanged
- Buffalo MK2 durability stats doubled, DP increased to 6 from 4
- Gemini and Condor's DP cost reduced by 2 (to 7 and 8 respectively)
- Gemini now has civ-grade and reduced burn speed. Now has combat carrier tags
- Drover now has Targeting Feed ship system
- Fulgent DP cost increased from 10 to 11
- Fulgent no longer has Bolt Coherer, High Energy Focus ship system replaced with Aurora's system
- Manticore Pather variant now costs the same amount of DP as its base variant

Cruisers:
- Falcon now costs 15 DP. The pirate Falcon variant now costs the same amount of DP as its base variant
- Eagle DP cost increased to 22
- Venture DP cost increased to 15. Now has a free hangar bay which can be equipped with whatever
- Venture no longer has civ-grade or related max burn penalty
- Pather Venture now has Safety Overrides
- Heron now uses Reserve Deployment and has combat carrier tags
- pirate and Pather Colossus variants DP costs reduced by 4
- Rampart DP cost increased from 15 to 20
- Brilliant now a semi-carrier. Reverted ship system to active flares, restored hangar bay with 1 hangar slot
- Anubis hullmod reworked, most negative effects removed, now only reduces base flux venting and capacity, and also reduces range by 20%
- Grendel ship system replaced with burn drive instead of ammo feed
- Mora no longer has combat carrier tags. Will now attempt to retreat from the enemy and stay at fighter range

Capitals:
- Astral DP cost reduced from 50 to 45
- Paragon reduced DP cost from 60 to 50
- Radiant reduced DP cost from 60 to 50
- Odyssey reduced DP cost from 45 to 40
- Guardian increased DP cost from 40 to 50
- Pegasus now has the same max speed and shield efficiency as the Executor
- Nova and Retribution hull durability and armour increased by 50%
- Removed civ-grade from Prometheus MK2 and Atlas MK2, these ships already had higher burn speed than their civillian counterparts
- Onslaught XIV now costs the same amount of DP as the standard Onslaught
- Increased Invictus flux venting and capacity stats to pre-nerf levels

Hullmod changes:
- ECCM package nerfed to provide far less max speed and turn rate. Now mostly a targeting-centric, anti-ECM, anti-flare hullmod
- Ill-advised probability of failures reduced by a factor of 10
- Targeting Supercomputer no longer provides any recoil reduction
- Design Compromises changes as mentioned with Anubis
- Integrated Point Defense AI no longer provides bonus damage against fighters and missiles. Now mostly useful for ignoring fighter flares and giving point-defense better targeting stats

Ship systems:
- Reduced damage reduction of Fortress Shield from 90% to 80%, now triggers and disables more quickly
- Entropy Amplifier now costs 20% flux of the ship that uses it instead of 75%
- Threat's Energy Lash now has a 75% base flux cost
- Degraded Phase Skimmer removed from the game
- Base Phase Skimmer nerfed to now have Degraded Phase Skimmer stats
- Termination Sequence now does 1k energy and 500 EMP damage and costs 1k flux to be used
- Quantum Disruptor renamed to Acausal Disruptor
- Reserve Wing now deploys 1 or 2 fighters respectively. Depending on whether the wing has less than 3 fighters per wing
- Damper now reduces damage by 75% for frigates and destroyers
- Phase Cloak stress mechanic removed from the game, Phase Cloak stress related hullmod also removed from the game
- High Energy Focus now increases damage taken by weapons and engines
- Ammo feed now has 30% flux cost reduction instead of 50%
- Microburn (Shrike's ship system) will no longer cause flameout on impact

Skills:
- Crew Training now additionally increases peak operating time by 30 seconds
- The two officer related skills in technology and industry tree can now be picked without any other skills present
- Remote survey is now unlocked by Salvaging instead of Makeshift Equipment skill

Ballistics:
- Light AC now has the same recoil stats as Light Dual AC
- Light Dual AC now has the same range as Light AC
- Light AG, Heavy Mauler, Heph AG recoil drastically increased
- Assault Chaingun now has 700 range and does 60 damage per projectile instead of 75
- Storm Needler reverted to before its rework into being a burst weapon
- Thumper increased flux consumption from 25 to 30 per bullet

Missiles:
- Atropos' damage increased to 1250
- Hammer can now steer to reach their target, but very little
- Harpoon's and Atropos' max speed increased by 100 units
- Harpoon now launches 2 missiles instead of 4
- Gorgon and Dragon now trigger instantly when they reach their target
- Gorgon damage increased to 1k from 800. Now has 2 and 8 ammo respectively per mount
- Gorgon (small), Dragon (medium), Gazer weapon mounts refire delay lessened
- Gazer now fires 2 projectiles on small weapon mounts and 4 per medium
- Sabot and Squall restored pre-nerfed EMP damage
- Restored Squall pre-nerfed durability of 300 instead of 150
- Hydra and Hurricane increased the amount of submunitions by 2
- Locust deacceleration stats reduced from 2.5k to 800
- Pilum's first phase projectile speed increased
- Salamanders now deal 500 fragmentation and 750 EMP damage
- Annihilator ammunition increased to 7, 70, 140 respectively per weapon mount (the first one is the fighter's one)

Energy:
- PD Laser and LR PD Laser range reduced by 100 and 200 to 400 and 800 respectively
- Autopulse reduced max charges to 20 from 30
- Heavy Burst Laser and PD Burst reduced the amount of charges by 1
- Heavy Burst damage reduced by 50, from 450 to 400
- Increased Paladin PD's flux spending to 750 a second, instead of 200
- Increased AMB's ammo capacity to 20 from 14
- Increased Pulse Laser's flux cost from 80 to 100
- Increased Phase Lance's flux cost from 900 to 1200 per second
- Reduced HIL's damage from 500 to 400
- Reduced Gigacannon's damage from 2500 to 2000
- Increased IR Autolance's flux consumption from 150 to 200 flux per second

Fighters:
- Broadsword, Warthog, Sarissa, Gladius flux stats drastically increased
- Claw now uses a standard EMP Ion Cannon instead of a High Delay one
- Gladius now uses 2 standard IR Pulse Lasers and 1 Light Dual MG instead of an IR Pulse Laser (high delay) and 2 LMGs
- Gladius now has single flare instead of multiple
- Piranha is now equipped with a Vulcan cannon on top of its bombs
- Sarissa now equipped with Ballistic Rangefinder
- Talon now launches standard Swarmer launchers instead of nerfed (fighter) ones
- Thunder now has Ion Cannon, Harpoon (double), Swarmer instead of Ion Cannon, Light Dual MG and Swarmer (fighter) as its weapon loadout. Mobility buffs reverted from before an update ago
- Warthog now equipped with a Light AG on top of its 2 Light Mortars
- Lux now equipped with a standard IR Pulse Laser instead of a High Delay one
- Increased Warthog roaming range from 2k to 3k
- Increased Thunder roaming range from 6k to 8k
- Perdition now costs 15 OP instead of 18, reduced respawn timer from 15 to 10
- Cobra and Perdition crew values swapped to being 1 and 4, instead of 4 and 1 respectively
- Flash, Spark and Lux roaming ranges increased from 4k to 5k
- Trident OP cost increased from 20 to 25 again
- Cobra wing now has 2 Cobras per wing
- Reverted Cobra shield durability and angle buff

General balance:
- Added an option to play at 800 max DP instead of 400, the 400 is still the default
- Doubled the amount of maximum and minimum pirate and Pather bases
- pirate and Pather bases will now scale more rapidly
- Persean League now has access to Autopulse Laser to provide Yesod station proper weapons
- Tri-Tachyon now has access to LMG to provide their civilian ships and orbital stations with proper point defense weapons

Description and explanation:

Spoiler
Hello, and welcome... To hell!
Did you ever wish fighters were broken? Like they had too many guns? And they freaking shredded you? Did you miss the time when fighters were really obnoxious and for some reason wanted to experience that for yourself? In a modern equivalent of that? WELL, this mod is for you then

HOWEVER, there are a few other interesting balance changes made.

Among others:
- Removed phase cloak stress and rebalanced some phase ships for optimal NPC usage
- Reverted some energy weapons to higher flux costs in order to nerf Remnants and large energy users, but also justify buffing some of them
- Extensive missile rebalance aimed to restore some of their old power (at the cost of however losing ECCM boosting)
- 700 range Chaingun
- Increased possible battlefield size for suffering more in Survival mode
- Greatly buffed pirate and Pather ships
- Rebalanced PTS shenanigans (for smaller and more believably-sized fleets, should make the game easier. Makes capitals and cruisers cost twice as many fleet points than what they would in vanilla. Making several capital ship fleets less common)
- Nerfed Threat. Overseer unit will now find it difficult to spam its ability constantly when pressured. Threat has higher DP costs to take longer to assemble and have less deployed enemies (though they are admittedly really overpowered after increasing the battlefield size, so you won't win anyway)

Subject to change:
- Do you think some of these changes suck? Let me know
